# Llama decor — light_blue — Material Reference

Create a high-quality standalone material appearance reference for the specific Mineclonia UV-aligned overlay/state layer below. It is a dependent layer, NOT a complete standalone creature skin. This is Image B guidance for the established Strict HQ UV → HQ UV + Reference two-pass workflow. Do not draw an atlas, UV template, voxel model, game screenshot, item, diagram, text or interface.

SUBJECT:
the llama's source-defined carpet decoration in dusty light-blue textile, tactile woven yarn, worn hems and legible original ornament. Preserve the actual source character, functional distinctions, landmarks and its specific variant or overlay role without adding shapes that are not part of the game asset.

ART DIRECTION:
Grounded dark-fantasy material realism; ancient, somber, tactile, physically coherent, low-to-medium contrast, restrained saturation and soft diffuse neutral light. Express finer fur, hide, bone, chitin, cloth, metal or energy microstructure according to THIS subject. Avoid enlarged pixel squares, synthetic crisp edge patterns, glossy toy surfaces, exaggerated damage and hard directional baked shadows.

REFERENCE FUNCTION:
Present the selected material close enough to read texture and variation on an unobtrusive neutral background. This layer later maps ONLY to its original occupied coordinates. Keep alpha/edge placement, separate base surfaces and runtime tint handling source-faithful. Image A remains the structurally correct HQ atlas, controlling all UV structure and anatomy. Transfer only controlled pigmentation, surface richness, natural material boundaries and age to it. No new background is to be painted into the actual edited texture.

AVOID:
No dramatic scenery, cinematic spotlights, camera blur, accessories, reimagined anatomy, new patterns, free glow field, typography, cartoon design or voxel shading. No whole llama skin, blanket redesign or added tassels.
